name: MAIA – Multipurpose AI Assistant
author: Avram

sections.description:
Hello there!

I am MAIA, an AI assistant for your WordPress website. A superstar WP developer, a writer, a know-it-all and your partner in WP website management.
I know a lot about your site and will be there 24/7 for you to help you manage your WordPress website. I can speak any language and can track multiple conversations.

You will have to sign in with a Puter.com account, but it shouldn’t be a problem as it is a single click process.

I am powered by Puter.com free AI, and I can help you with:
– writing your posts/pages
– writing your product descriptions (WooCommerce)
– extending WP via custom code snippets
– contemplating life and the Universe 🙂

Try instantly on tastewp.com!

External services

This plugin connects to a 3rd party API to provide AI chat services.
In order to provide context and knowledge about your website, on each request to the AI chat service the plugin sends the following information:
– site name, description, URL and default language
– currently logged in user data (without password) and assigned role(s)
– list of other users on the site (without passwords)
– list of all installed themes and the name of the currently active theme
– list of all installed plugins and the list of active plugins
– list of all pages on the site (without content)
– list of all blog posts on the site (without content)
– information about page or post currently being edited (with content), if editing pages/posts
– current URL (the URL of the page being viewed)

This service is provided by Puter.com: terms of use, privacy policy.

Important notes

  • Each (logged in) user of your website will have to sign up for a Puter.com account, which is free. This makes Puter account AI limits apply to each user separately.
  • Puter AI SDK is a JavaScript library that runs in the browser, so it does not require any server-side processing other than regular plugin bootstrapping.
  • The plugin does not store any data on your server, and all requests are made directly from the user’s browser to Puter.com, which enhances user privacy.
  • All conversations are stored in the browser’s local storage, so if you clear your browser’s local storage or change your browser, the plugin will lose all stored conversations.
sections.faq:
Q: Can it generate images?
A: No.

Q: Can it edit website content?
A: No, but it can help you write content that you can then copy and paste into your website.

Q: Can it edit website or theme files?
A: No, but it can help you write code snippets that you can then copy and paste into your theme or plugin files.

Q: Why is MAIA not responding?
A: Check if Puter.com is up and running. If it is, then check your usage in the right click context menu -> Puter AI -> About… Puter provides free limited usage, and if you exceed it, MAIA will not respond until your usage subsides.
